title: cluster: the metadata.mutated lane (lane 2) re-converges the ObjectQL registry on cluster.resync, so an object authored during a Redis outage is served by every replica without a restart (#31596 follow-up)
body:
domain:server#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmPF1skfu2kx89BEXZi

Filing gate: ④ coordination node, a child of #3814 that carries the part of #31596 (F3a) its PR #31721 leaves out. ⛔ Not a claim.
Business reason: #31596 is done when "caches converge without a restart" once Redis returns. PR #31721 adds the local `cluster.resync` event, and lanes 1, 3 and 4 and authz re-read on it. Lane 2 (`attachMetadataMutationPubSub()`, `metadata.mutated`) has no resync seam: `metadata-cluster-bridge-plugin.ts` on the PR head says "Lane 2 has no resync seam yet". Lane 2 is the one behind the data plane on the shipped EE shape (#13331). So an object authored through `PUT /api/v1/meta/*` while the store is unreachable loses its hint, and every other replica answers `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` for it until restart.
Reader: seat `domain:server#1`, serial after #31596's PR #31721 merges. It touches the same bridge file as #31597, so it runs on the same seat, one after another.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `metadata.mutated resync` → 0 on point; `#13331` (closed) is the lane's original defect, which lane 2 fixed for delivered hints.
class: b · type: Bug
Grade: p1, same as #31596 (#3814 HA critical path).

## 维护者速读

Redis 断线期间在某个副本上新建或修改的对象，恢复连接后别的副本仍然找不到，要重启才好。#31596 已经让其他三条缓存通道在重连时重读，这条负责对象注册表的通道还没有，这张卡补上。

## What to build

1. A resync seam on the metadata protocol lane's owner, registered with the bridge exactly as lanes 1, 3 and 4 register theirs in PR #31721 (`LaneResync`, called from `resyncLanes` on `onClusterResync`). On the event, the replica re-runs the ObjectQL registry write-through from its OWN `sys_metadata` read for every item a missed hint could have touched. Measure the cost of a full re-read against a per-type or since-timestamp re-read, and say which one you chose in the PR.
2. ⛔ No value travels on the wire; the DB stays the source of truth. ⛔ A resync never deletes a registry entry it cannot re-read (a transient read failure is not a delete). Log it once and keep the entry.
3. #3814 R3: the memory driver never emits the event, so the single-node path is unchanged. Pin that.
4. Tests: two kernels on a shared pub/sub. Drop A's `metadata.mutated` hint (the driver's fault seam or a dropped publish), author an object on A, and emit `cluster.resync` on B. B then serves the object. This is red without the seam. CONTROL: single node unchanged; a delivered hint still converges per item.
5. Update `content/docs/kernel/cluster.mdx` §6.2 so it no longer says lane 2 lacks the resync.

## Surface

- Expected file surface: `packages/services/service-cluster/src/metadata-cluster-bridge-plugin.ts`, the protocol lane's owner (where `attachMetadataMutationPubSub` lives), tests, `content/docs/kernel/cluster.mdx`, root `.changeset/`.
- Clause-②: no.

Parent: #31596. Epic: #3814.
